safety_boundaries: Rules are reusable concept patterns; no document, year, or question identifiers are classification exceptions.
Combined-subject papers without trustworthy subject context abstain instead of enabling all PCM rules.
Headerless JEE Advanced subject inference runs only for exactly three END-delimited blocks with decisive lexical assignment evidence.
Near-duplicate candidates are reported for review and are never merged automatically.
Classification never assigns answers, difficulty, or reviewed status.
limitations: Every extracted document still has splitter diagnostics requiring human review, so all 783 records remain candidate-only.
OCR can damage mathematical notation, diagrams, option layout, and paragraph-child question boundaries.
Deterministic rules are a high-precision candidate filter, not proof of exhaustive topic recall.
The source inventory has explicit historical gaps; corpus counts must not be described as every paper from 2000 through 2026.
